deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 1% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 250% last year; 105%/yr over 3 years — the market expects a slowdown from its recent pace.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 87% (3 years ago -10%, rising) — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $87 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 61% (3 years ago -13%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $134.0B — about 1.0× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $13.0B, up from $169M a year ago.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 105%/yr over 3 years and 37%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 75% vs a 5-year range of -41–75% (median 24%): near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back).
